sentences.en: Somebody tipped off the gang members to the police surveillance.
sentences.zh: 有人向警方举报了那伙人，他们已经知道了。

sentences.en: You were acting suspicious, so they had you under surveillance.
sentences.zh: 你行为可疑，所以一直被监视。

sentences.en: Earthlings became under alien surveillance that prevented a major war.
sentences.zh: 地球人受到了外星人的监视，从而避免了一场大战。
